summary.zh: 用 Jest 与 Vitest 写单元和集成测试
summary.en: Unit, integration, and end-to-end tests with Jest and Vitest

description.zh: 覆盖 Jest、Vitest 与 Testing Library 的单元、集成和端到端测试写法，包括 mock、fixture 与 TDD 流程。适合新建测试体系，或给已有项目补齐测试覆盖。需要安装所选测试框架及依赖。
description.en: Covers unit, integration, and end-to-end tests with Jest, Vitest, and Testing Library, including mocks, fixtures, and TDD. Use it to set up test infrastructure or raise coverage. Requires the chosen test packages.
